prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm golden-brown complexion, late 20s goddess, legendary bust physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her upper body so wide; a mythologically, legendarily enormous bust dominates her entire silhouette, resting heavy and full, far wider than her own shoulders and projecting well forward of the rest of her body, the single defining feature of her frame, every other curve secondary to it; below it a waistline still draws in with a visible inward pull, round hips and soft thighs continue her curves; her head looks small in comparison to her massive bust; the bust is unmistakably, overwhelmingly the dominant feature; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, waist-length braids ash brown hair — wearing a tight cropped sleeveless champagne ivory silk zip-front top with a high collar, a chrome front zipper unzipped from the collar all the way down to her belly button where the chrome slider rests at her navel, the two zipper edges with their metal teeth running in a long deep V along her sternum and stomach, each side of the top covering one breast, paired with a champagne ivory silk micro-mini skirt with its hem at the very top of her thighs, fully opaque and covering only what it must, her midriff bare below the zipper. Her waist wears a black leather waist harness of one narrow belt around her waist and a second narrow belt around her hips, joined by four thin vertical straps over her stomach with a small silver ring at every junction, framing her navel. Pose: leaning a shoulder against the doorway, one knee bent, a hand on her thigh — most extreme legendary bust silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, knee-high lace-up platform stiletto boots made of champagne ivory silk, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each longer than her middle finger, in glossy champagne lacquer with a high polish.
Body glitter: fine gold shimmer dusted over her shoulders, collarbones and thighs, sparkling on the skin.
Jewelry: thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee, a black leather collar with a small silver ring at the front, snug around her neck, from which a long fine silver chain falls diagonally across her torso and swings down to her left hip, ending in a small silver tassel that hangs at her hip, and large drop earrings of mixed metals, a gold chain ending in a heavy iron weight on one ear and a silver chain ending in a big pearl on the other, hanging above her collarbones. Jewelry is metal and pearl only.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Indian woman with large almond eyes, strong brows and a defined nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: a bold black graphic crease line drawn high above each eyelid, very thick false lashes on the top lids, small painted lash strokes beneath each lower lid, soft lilac-white eyeshadow, large eyes with bright real catchlights, natural brows, a soft peachy-white lip.

Background: a sunlit white-washed courtyard with a pale tiled floor, an arched doorway at normal height, low stone steps and a waist-high wall, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on the fabric texture, the skin and the shadows. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
